description: This file contains functions and types for managing agent run states, including waiting for agent runs, reading chat history snapshots, normalizing responses, and testing dependencies. It interacts with a gateway API for communication.

methods.name: normalizeAgentWaitResult
methods.description: Normalizes raw agent wait response into a structured result with status, error, start and end times.

methods.name: normalizePendingRunIds
methods.description: Removes duplicates and trims run IDs from an iterable of run IDs.

methods.name: resolveLatestAssistantReplySnapshot
methods.description: Finds the latest assistant message in a list of messages and extracts its text and fingerprint.
